Description: Remove existing interior partitions, doors, and windows as shown on A-2 demo plan. Install temporary support walls at load-bearing removals. Protect areas not in scope. Patch/repair subfloor where damaged.
Remove existing interior partitions, doors, and windows on 2nd floor per demo plan A-2. Prepare for 526 SF expansion.
Remove existing porch concrete floor (~163 SF) and foundation completely. Remove existing front steps. Per demo notes on A-2.
Remove existing roof at expansion portion completely - shingles, felt, sheathing, and partial framing. Install temporary weatherproofing. ~450 SF roof area.
Remove existing tub, basin (lavatory), and W.C. at existing bath. Remove all finishes - tile, drywall as required for new configuration. Per demo note on A-2 (DEMO-04: 60-80 SF).
Install new 1/2" gypsum board on interior side of all new exterior walls and both sides of interior partitions in expansion area. ~2,200 SF (CARP-10: $4/SF).
Install new 5/8" gypsum board ceilings in all expansion areas. ~635 SF (CARP-11: $4.95/SF).
Install cement board or Hardy board at interior side of all bathroom walls per construction note #12 on A-3. ~250 SF of bathroom wall area.
Repair and patch existing drywall where partitions removed, walls modified, and openings infilled on both existing floors. Spackle, sand, smooth finish per note 13.5. ~400 SF.

Complete new rough-in: LAV (1-1/2" drain, 1-1/4" vent), WC (3" drain, 2" vent), shower (2" drain). 3" vent through roof. Connect to existing sanitary sewer. Modify existing plumbing as required. Per riser diagram A-4 (PLMB-04: relocation, 60-80 SF).
Install new lavatory/sink, toilet (WC), and shower fixtures. All fixtures selected by owner, per note #5 on A-3. Coordinate roughing dimensions with owner selections per note #20 (PLMB-13/14/15).
Install LED downlights throughout expansion areas - bedrooms, hallways, bathroom, kitchen. ~20 units (ELEC-09: $165 labor + $25 material).
Contractor to provide and install fan/light combo fixtures in bedrooms. ~4 units per electrical plan A-4 note #2 (ELEC-02: $175).
Install new duplex electrical outlets (20) and GFI outlets (5) throughout expansion areas. GFI in bathroom and kitchen per code. White plates per note #6 (ELEC-01: $125, ELEC-07: $80).
Install new light switches including 3-way and dimmer. All centerlines at 48" AFF per note #3. White plates. ~15 units (ELEC-04: $80).
Hardwired smoke detectors and carbon monoxide/smoke combo detectors per code. ~6 units. Plus ceiling recessed mechanical vent/light in bathroom.
Attic: (1) 125V 20A outlet within 25' of HVAC, (3) LED lights, switch on 2nd floor per note #12. Exterior: (4) weatherproof light fixtures with motion/light sensors. Doorbell.
Upgrade existing electrical panel or install sub-panel to accommodate all new circuits for expansion areas. Per riser diagram A-4 (ELEC-17: existing location).
Install hardwood floors in all new expansion areas except bathroom and corridor (tile). Per note #16 on A-3. ~500 SF (FINSH-03: $12/SF).
Install/repair hardwood flooring in existing areas where partitions removed and layout reconfigured. Patch to match existing. ~300 SF (FINSH-11: $12/SF install & refinish).
Install porcelain floor tile in bathroom. ~70 SF. Tile selected by owner, installed by GC. Per note #16 on A-3 (TILE-04: 60-80 SF).
Install ceramic tile wainscot 3'-8" high on all bathroom walls per note #17 on A-3. Tile selected by owner. ~90 SF wall tile (TILE-03: 60-80 SF).
Install porcelain tile in common corridor/hall areas per note #16 on A-3. ~60 SF. Includes marble saddles with eased edge at all bathroom doors.

Prime (1 coat) + paint (2 coats) all new and modified walls and ceilings. Benjamin Moore or equal. Walls: eggshell finish. Ceilings: white eggshell. All trims: semi-gloss white. Per notes 13.1-13.5, 18, 19 on A-3. ~1,500 SF floor area (FINSH-05: $10.50/SF).
Install 4" wood baseboard throughout all new and modified areas per note #15 on A-3. Profile selected by owner. ~350 LF (TRIM-01: $11/LF supply + install).
Install 3" wood trim on both sides of all new doors per note #22 on A-3. Profile to match existing or selected by owner. ~12 doors × 17 LF each = 204 LF.
Supply standard-grade kitchen cabinets per owner selection. ~12 LF estimated. Purchased by GC per note #23 on A-3 (KITC-10: $800/LF).
Install kitchen cabinets per manufacturer specs. 11-15 LF (KITC-07: $9,200).
Supply and install bathroom vanity cabinet. Selected by owner, per note #23 (BATH-01: $950).
Install hanging coat rod and (2) hat shelves in all hanging closets. Full-height adjustable shelving where noted per notes #3/#4 on A-3. ~5 closets (MISC-13: $1,155 each).
Supply and install laundry closet cabinets per owner selection. Per note #23 on A-3.
Supply quartz slab, template, fabricate and install kitchen countertop. ~25 SF. Includes sink cutout and edge profile (STON-01 + STON-02).
Install standard marble saddles with eased edge at all bathroom doors. Per note #16 on A-3.
Install tile backsplash in kitchen (TILE-10: <10ft kitchen).
Install kitchen appliances selected by owner: refrigerator, range/oven, dishwasher. Per manufacturer specs and code per notes #23/#25 on A-3 (APPL-01/02/03).
All building permits: structural, electrical, plumbing, HVAC. City of Clifton, NJ. Per general condition 1.4.
Temporary support walls at load-bearing wall removals. Temporary weatherproofing during roof work. Site protection, barriers, and temporary lighting per OSHA and notes 1.16-1.18.
Multiple dumpster rentals for demolition debris, construction waste, and final cleanup. Extended project duration for 2-story addition.
Post-construction cleaning of entire house, all new and existing areas. ~2,518 SF proposed total area (CLEN-04: 1800-2500 SF).
Panel and door shower enclosure (one fixed, one door). Tempered glass per note #2 on A-3 (MISC-23).
Install bathroom accessories: towel bars, toilet paper holder, medicine cabinet/mirror, robe hooks. All selected by owner (MISC-09: $550 each).
4" reinforced concrete slab with 6×6-W1.4×W1.4 WWF over 4" compacted gravel and waterproofing. 1/8" slope to exterior. ~28 SF proposed porch. CMU block footings. Per note #9 on A-3.
New concrete front stairs with code-compliant railings both sides. Max riser 7.5", min tread 10". Coordinate with surveyor. Submit shop drawings for architect approval. Per note #8 on A-3.
Install Tyvek housewrap or equal on all new exterior walls. ~886 SF per REScheck.
New vinyl siding throughout entire house per elevation notes (U.O.N.). New expansion walls (~886 SF) plus re-siding existing exterior to match. Total ~2,200 SF.
White board and batten finish on front elevation as shown on A-4 front elevation. ~200 SF accent area.
White PVC trim work as shown on all elevations. Typical corner trim at all building corners. ~150 LF.
Cement parge/stucco finish on all exposed masonry foundation walls. Per left side elevation note A-4.
6"×6" Fypon or equal decorative column wraps on 4×4 wood posts supporting porch roof. Style selected by owner. ~3 columns per A-3 note.
New guard railings: 42" high at 2nd floor per note #1 on A-3, 36" high at stairs per note #7. Code-compliant with infill. Both sides of all stairs. Style selected by owner.
Excavate for new foundation walls. Min 36" below grade per code (3'-6" min frost depth, NJ Zone 5A). ~45 LF perimeter × 3.5' deep × 2' wide.
10" concrete block foundation walls (8" where noted). Solid fill all CMU at column/beam locations. ~45 LF × 8' height = 360 SF. Per structural notes A-2.
24"×12" continuous poured concrete footings with (3) #4 rebar continuous. Min 36" below grade. 2"×4" continuous keyway. ~45 LF. Concrete 3,000 PSI.
4" reinforced concrete floor slab with 6×6/8-8 WWF on 4" gravel bed and 10 mil poly vapor barrier. ~109 SF first floor expansion. Concrete 3,000 PSI.
Drill 18" deep holes in existing foundation, install #4 rebar dowels 3'-0" long with epoxy adhesive to tie new foundation to existing. All locations per A-2.
CertainTeed Platon or equal waterproof membrane on exterior of new foundation walls. Cement parge coat. 4" drain tile. Backfill and compact to 95% density per ASTM D1557.

Extend existing HVAC system to all 635 SF of expansion. New ductwork, supply registers, and returns. Service, clean, and provide new filters for existing units. Balance system by qualified technician. Per HVAC notes 10.1-10.7.
R-15 paper-backed fiberglass batt between studs + R-3 continuous rigid foam board on exterior (Dow 1194 or equal). Vapor barrier on warm side. All new exterior walls ~886 SF per REScheck Zone 5A.
10.5" batt insulation R-38 with vapor barrier on warm side at flat ceiling/attic floor. ~323 SF per REScheck.
9" batt insulation R-30 at floors over unheated spaces (109 SF) + R-38 at floor over outside air (38 SF 2nd floor overhang). Total ~147 SF.
Spray foam insulation at exterior wall with plumbing to prevent frozen pipes. Per construction note #10 on A-3.
New roof: 2×10 rafters at 16" O.C., 6:12 pitch. 2×10 ridge beams, 2×12 hip and valley rafters. 2×6 collar ties at 16" O.C. (2)2×4 vertical supports. ~700 SF roof area over expansion per A-5.
1/2" CDX plywood exterior-grade roof sheathing, supported at all edges. ~700 SF.
New asphalt roof shingles (min 20-year lifespan) over 15# roofing felt. Installed per manufacturer specifications. ~700 SF. Per elevation notes A-4.
Continuous aluminum gutters and leaders/downspouts. 26 gauge metal counter-flashing, penetration flashing, and base flashing. ~80 LF gutters. Per A-4 roof notes.
Aluminum soffit bead board with ventilation holes. 2" continuous vent at ridge. (2) solar-powered attic fans with heat sensors. Per electrical notes A-4.
New floor joists 2×10 at 16" O.C. over new foundation. Double joists under partitions. (2) layers 5/8" plywood subflooring. ~109 SF expansion. Design: 40 PSF live + 12 PSF dead.

New floor joists 2×10 at 16" O.C. for 526 SF second floor expansion. Double joists at pressure points and under partitions. (2) layers 5/8" plywood subflooring. Rim joist. Design: 30 PSF live + 12 PSF dead.
New exterior walls: 2×4 wood studs at 16" O.C. with (2)2×4 top plates. 1/2" exterior-grade plywood sheathing on exterior side. ~886 SF total new wall area per REScheck. Douglas Fir #2 or better.
New interior partitions: 2×4 wood studs at 16" O.C., 1/2" gypsum board both sides. 3-1/2" sound insulation at all bedroom and bathroom walls. ~200 LF per construction plans A-3 (CARP-01).

Supply and install Weyerhaeuser Microllam LVL beams per framing plan A-5: (3) 1-3/4"×9-1/2" 2.0E flush beams + (2) 1-3/4"×7-1/2" 2.0E drop beams. Bearing plates, 4×4 support posts, 1/2" thru-bolts at 24" O.C.
Install (2)2×8 lintels over openings <3'-0" wide and (2)2×10 lintels over openings 3'-6' wide with 1/2" ply packout. ~15 openings per framing notes A-5.

CS16 straps at 48" O.C., anchor tie-down at 72" O.C., H2 hurricane anchors at all rafters, SST rafter-to-ridge straps, joist hangers at all flush connections, MST floor-to-floor straps. Per structural notes.
Patch, repair, and replace existing subfloor, floor joists, and/or concrete slab where damaged throughout area of work. Per demo note #3 on A-2. Allowance.
Install waterproofing on bathroom floors and shower walls. Complete shower pan waterproofing (WATR-02: 60-80 SF).

Supply and install Andersen 400 series TW3046 double-hung tilt-wash, 3'-0"W × 4'-6"H. Dual glazed, vinyl white, screens. Egress compliant (5.7 SF clear opening, 24" min height, 20" min width). ~10 windows. Per schedule A-3.
Supply and install Andersen 400 series TW26210 double-hung tilt-wash, 2'-6"W × 2'-10"H. Dual glazed, vinyl white, screens. ~4 windows. Adjacent windows ordered as single combined units.
Standard solid core painted wood doors with raised panels, prehung. Various sizes per schedule: (4) 2'-6"×6'-8", (2) 2'-4"×6'-8", (2) 2'-0"×6'-8". Hardware by owner. 3" trim both sides (DOOR-01).
Standard solid core painted wood sliding closet doors, 5'-0"W × 6'-8"H. ~3 units per schedule (DOOR-04: $825).
Half-glazed exterior door, 3'-0"W × 6'-8"H with sidelite. Selected by owner, installed by GC. Tempered glass. Per door schedule type 5.
Infill existing wall where windows/doors removed. Match existing wall construction with new studs, sheathing, insulation, and drywall. Per demo note #8 on A-2.
